title: tenant-aligned-commit-rescheduler-and-proactive-erosion-guard
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Introduce commit rescheduler and proactive erosion guard to smooth decommits and reduce tenant-facing SLO violations during capacity churn.
description: Context: We observed fast fractional decommits (capacity reclamation/spot churn) causing synchronized quota chops that produced transient throughput and latency SLO regressions for mid-tier tenants. This PR implements a tenant-aligned commit rescheduler plus a proactive erosion guard to make decommits gradual, reduce KV-cache thrash, and preserve downstream SLAs. Motivation: avoid immediate, simultaneous capacity reductions across pools and instead apply tenant-scoped, observable, reversible changes. High-level changes: 1) Commit Rescheduler (controller): batches commit/delta events per tenant and applies them in an idempotent transactional window; enforces per-tenant commit pace and adds randomized jitter to avoid cross-tenant sync. 2) Transactional Apply Path: lightweight two-phase apply for reservation changes (prepare -> validate -> commit) with rollback hooks on transient failures (e.g., warm pool shortfall). 3) Proactive Erosion Guard: converts immediate fractional decommits into a decayed ramp-down using exponential decay plus a minimum hold window to prevent abrupt SLA impact. 4) Telemetry & Auditing: new metrics and audit events (tenant_commit_applied, tenant_commit_deferred, erosion_guard_triggered) and an SLI probe for per-tenant decommit latency. 5) Tests & scenarios: integration test simulates spot preemptions across two zones and asserts <=2% 95th percentile latency regression for protected tenants. Checklist: [x] design doc ENG-3245 linked; [x] controller + reconciliation implemented; [x] transactional apply + rollback; [x] erosion guard algorithm + knobs; [x] telemetry + dashboards; [x] unit + integration tests; [x] docs and helm samples. Commits summary: feat(rescheduler): tenant commit rescheduler and reconciliation window; feat(apply): transactional reservation apply API and rollback helpers; feat(erosion): proactive erosion guard with decay policy; feat(metrics): tenant_commit_* metrics and audit events; test(e2e): simulated-spot-decommit scenario; infra: helm values and console flags for rescheduler. Config knobs (defaults): rescheduler.window_ms=2000; rescheduler.max_batch_per_window=5; rescheduler.jitter_ms=150; erosion.decay_half_life_s=120; erosion.min_hold_s=30. Files touched (high-level): services/autoscaler/controller/rescheduler.go (new); services/autoscaler/apply/transactional_apply.go (new); services/autoscaler/erosion/guard.go (new); pkg/telemetry/metrics.go (metrics additions); web/console/src/features/dedicated/commit-controls.tsx (UI toggles); helm/redwood/values.dedicated.yaml (config knobs); test/e2e/spot_decommit_sim_test.go (integration); test/unit/rescheduler_test.go (unit coverage). Small loop excerpt: for each tenant in pendingQueue { batch := drainBatch(tenant, cfg.maxBatch); if shouldApply(batch) { applyTx(ctx, batch); } else { deferWithJitter(tenant, cfg.jitterMs); } } Metrics added: tenant_commit_attempt_total (counter), tenant_commit_applied_total (counter), tenant_commit_deferred_total (counter), erosion_guard_events_total (counter), tenant_decommit_latency_ms (histogram). Backwards compatibility: transactional apply is opt-in via feature flag "enableTransactionalApply" and defaulted on for Dedicated clusters after a soft rollout. Review conversation (abridged): Evan Brooks: "Add audit log entry for every deferred commit and per-tenant deferred counters"; Maya Patel: "Added tenant_commit_deferred_total and audit event; surfaced deferred_window_count metric"; Samira Liu: "Concerned about rescheduler queue memory during bursts"; Maya Patel: "Per-tenant queue length limited to 100 with eviction and tombstone audit events; tests added"; Carlos Ortega: "CI flake on e2e timing, suggest looser timing assertion"; Maya Patel: "Adjusted e2e tolerance to +/-200ms and reran CI". CI summary: Build: passed; Unit tests: passed (coverage +0.6%); Integration/e2e: initially flaky then passed on rerun; Lint: passed; Helm/chart check: passed. Merge outcome: Merged via squash on 2025-02-18 by Samira Liu. Rollout plan: canary to 10% Dedicated clusters for 48h (feature flag off by default, enable via console toggle in canary); monitor tenant_commit_deferred_total and tenant_decommit_latency_ms; rollback if >3% increase in protected-tenant 95th latency; ramp to 100% over 7 days if stable. Notes: This moves immediate synchronous quota cuts to an intention-first, tenant-scoped commit cadence that is observable and reversible, reducing synchronized KV cache invalidation and spikey traffic patterns at the cost of small eventuality. Related work: ENG-3245 design doc, PR 31102 (utilization metrics), PR 33457 (autoscaler signal smoothing). Backports: will prepare a backport to release/2025.02 if QA agrees.
